paragraphs.source_en: “This man is from the port of Sakai. His name is Kōbei, and he can be trusted.”

units.source_en: “This man is from the port of Sakai. His name is Kōbei, and he can be trusted.”

paragraphs.source_en: “For now, I shall trust you. What is it?” Yukimura asked, cautiously retreating a step. For the man exuded an air that irresistibly called to mind the fearsome fighting spirit of the Iga and Kōga ninja.

paragraphs.source_en: “Quickly—tell His Lordship exactly what you have learned, leaving nothing out.” Iki Shichirōemon urged him in a low voice.
